title: Peripatetic Administrator
description:

Our Administrators are relied upon to ensure income and outgoings are timely, effective, and accurately recorded, so strong commercial acumen is key to this position. You will provide HR advice to your General Manager as well as home-based staff, and supervise junior members of the administration team
Here at Barchester, we work with an open, honest, supportive approach, where quality of care is at the heart of everything we do. As sector leading healthcare experts, we are proud to have the highest quality ratings across our 224 homes and hospitals across the UK.
Barchester have proudly been awarded a two-star outstanding rating by Best Companies, ranked 11th in the top 20 Best Health & Social Care Companies to work for and 14th in the Top 25 Best Big Companies to Work For in the UK.

NEED TO HAVE
Good level of numeracy skills
Strong commercial acumen
Experience within credit control, invoice chasing, purchase/sales ledgers, payroll, management accounts
Full UK driving licence
Proficient user of Microsoft- specifically Word, Excel and Outlook
AAT/NVQ Level 2 in Administration would be beneficial
NEED TO DO
Work with the Regional Director to understand where support is needed
Check Management Accounts are correct, understand implications
Ensure aged debt is collected and managed appropriately, encouraging timely payment of client accounts
Promote a warm and welcoming environment for residents, families, and Barchester staff
Ensure rota's are complete
Complete employment checks and payroll for home-based staff
Demonstrate a positive and professional attitude both over the telephone and in person
Supervise and support the home's administration team
Manage safe contents
REWARDS AND BENEFITS
Unlimited access to our generous refer a friend scheme, earning up to £500 per referral
Access to a wide range of retail and leisure discounts at big brands and supermarkets
Free access to medical specialists, who are available for a second opinion if you need it to make a decision with confidence

Option to join our monthly staff lottery alongside thousands of colleagues across the UK
Terms & conditions apply

title: Junior Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Support Administrator

Location: Bury St Edmunds

Salary: Competitive, depending on experience

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Salary: £27,000 p.a.

Are you organised, detail-focused and looking to build your career within Accounts and Finance?

We're looking for an Accounts Support Administrator to join a busy accounts team, providing essential administrative and data support across the department.

This is a great opportunity for someone with previous office or administration experience who is keen to develop their knowledge of accounts. Full training will be provided, with the opportunity to gain hands-on experience across areas such as purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control, invoice processing and reconciliations.

The Role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Accurately inputting and updating information across internal systems, databases and spreadsheets.
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date electronic records.
- Checking data and documentation for completeness and accuracy.
- Producing routine reports and information for the Accounts team.
- Updating spreadsheets, trackers and departmental records.
- Processing and uploading electronic documentation.
- Identifying missing information and following up where necessary.
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to the wider Accounts team.
- Assisting with routine accounts processing and administration.
- Obtaining information and documentation from other departments when required.
- Supporting customer and supplier documentation and routine enquiries.
- Answering incoming telephone calls in a professional and helpful manner.
- Monitoring shared email inboxes and ensuring enquiries are dealt with or passed to the appropriate team member.
- Providing administrative support during busy periods and holiday/absence cover.
- Maintaining confidentiality when handling financial and business information.
- Working collaboratively with colleagues across the wider Accounts team.
- Supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the department.
- Undertaking training and development to build your knowledge of Accounts and Finance.

About You

This role would suit someone who is organised, reliable and keen to learn, with a genuine interest in developing a career within accounts.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in an administrative or office-based role.
- Experience of accurate data entry and maintaining electronic records.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel.
- Confidence using computer systems and spreadsheets.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to prioritise your workload.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- A confident and professional telephone manner.
- The ability to follow established processes and instructions.
- The ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
- A positive, helpful and proactive attitude.
- A willingness to ask questions, learn and develop new skills.

Previous experience within an Accounts or Finance environment would be beneficial, as would experience using financial systems or Excel for reporting, but this is not essential.

Training & Progression

This is a fantastic opportunity to learn and develop within an established Accounts team.

Full training will be provided on the relevant systems and processes, with the opportunity to gain practical experience in:
- Purchase Ledger
- Sales Ledger
- Credit Control
- Invoice Processing
- Reconciliations
- Wider Financial Administration

As your knowledge, skills and confidence develop, there is the potential to progress into an Accounts Administrator position.

If you're looking for a role where you can get your foot in the door of Accounts, learn on the job and build a long-term career, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Administrator

Location: Bury St Edmunds

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

Salary: £30,000 p.a.

We're looking for an organised and detail-focused Accounts Administrator to join a busy and friendly accounts team in Woolpit.

This is a varied role offering exposure across purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control and general accounts administration. You'll play an important part in ensuring financial transactions are processed accurately and on time, while supporting the wider accounts team with day-to-day administration and month-end activities.

The Role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Processing high-volume purchase ledger invoices, including manual and EDI invoices.
- Checking invoices for accuracy and resolving any discrepancies promptly.
- Supporting the processing of supplier payments and ensuring records are kept up to date.
- Assisting with sales ledger and credit control activities when required.
- Making outbound calls to customers regarding outstanding payments.
- Allocating customer payments and assisting with unallocated cash.
- Dealing with customer and supplier queries in a professional and timely manner.
- Preparing, sending and maintaining accurate invoice records.
- Reviewing and reconciling accounts to ensure accuracy.
- Maintaining accurate records of invoices, receipts and financial transactions.
- Updating accounting systems, spreadsheets and internal databases.
- Managing Proof of Delivery (POD) requests from customers and suppliers.
- Maintaining monthly rebate records and supporting reconciliations.
- Assisting with bank deposits and ensuring transactions are accurately recorded.
- Supporting month-end procedures and financial reporting.
- Providing holiday and absence cover across the wider accounts team.
- Liaising with other departments and teams to resolve queries and keep processes running smoothly.
- Identifying discrepancies and taking the necessary action to resolve them.
- Supporting continuous improvements to accounts administration processes.
- Carrying out other accounts and administrative duties as required.

About You

We're looking for someone with previous experience within an accounts or finance environment, ideally with exposure to purchase ledger, sales ledger and/or credit control.

You'll ideally have:
- Previous experience in an accounts or finance administration role.
- Experience working in a busy, high-volume transactional environment.
- Good knowledge of purchase ledger and/or sales ledger processes.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Good written and verbal communication skills.
- A confident and professional telephone manner.
- Good customer service skills and the ability to build positive relationships.
- Competent Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Outlook and Word.
- The ability to work under pressure while maintaining accuracy and meeting deadlines.
- The ability to work independently as well as being a supportive team player.
- A proactive and flexible approach, with a willingness to learn and take on new responsibilities.

What's on Offer?

This is a great opportunity for an experienced Accounts Administrator looking for a varied role with plenty of exposure across the wider accounts function.

You'll receive training and support and, once established in the role, there is the opportunity to develop your skills and progress within the accounts team, gaining experience across different areas of finance and administration.

If you're organised, reliable and looking for your next opportunity within accounts, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Commercial Claims Handler
description:
Our Client, an Insurance Broker, is looking to recruit another Commercial Claims Handler to join their friendly and growing team.

You will also be able to attend renewal meetings with your Account Executives, and the occasional quarterly Claims meetings.

Your main responsibilities as a Commercial Claims Handler will include:
- Receiving and actioning Claims instructions in a timely manner
- Negotiating to reach the best settlement possible for our clients whilst maintaining a good relationship with Insurers
- Liaise and advise clients, colleagues and insurers on claims procedures, queries and technical liability queries
- Ensuring claims are processed within agreed standard practices and procedures
- Creating and maintaining Claims files electronically
- Obtaining Claims agreement as per contract conditions or within appropriate timescales to ensure secure, efficient, and auditable handling of client monies
- Communicating with carriers, third parties and service providers

To be successful as a Commercial Claims Handler in this role you will have:
- Claims Handling experience
- Excellent communication and negotiation skills
- Strong work ethic and customer focus with a drive to achieve best possible settlements
- Ability to convey a professional and confident image

title: Aquarius Relationship and Placement Coordinator
description:
Aquarius is a digitally enabled placement solution designed to streamline SME business and deliver efficient, data-driven outcomes for clients and insurers. The Aquarius Facility Placement Coordinator plays a key role in supporting the continued delivery and success of the Willis Aquarius proposition. This role is responsible for coordinating the end-to-end placement journey for SME risks within the Aquarius facility, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and a high standard of service to both Network Broker partners and insurer panel members. The successful candidate will support the execution of authorised facility activities, including binding through digital placement platforms, while maintaining strong relationships across all stakeholders. The role sits at the centre of the Aquarius operating model, acting as a key link between brokers, insurers, and internal teams.

The Role:
Placement Coordination
- Manage and coordinate risks throughout the Aquarius placement journey from submission to binding and policy issuance
- Run authorised activities in line with facility governance, including binding via approved systems/platforms
- Ensure timely progress of risks and adherence to agreed service levels

Technical & Documentation Oversight
- Undertake technical checks on all documentation (quotes, schedules, policy outputs) to ensure accuracy and alignment with agreed terms
- Ensure outputs reflect the information provided by brokers and insurers
- Support the issuance process and liaise with relevant checking teams where required

Broker & Insurer Engagement
- Act as a key point of contact for Willis Network Broker partners and facility insurers
- Maintain strong working relationships to support collaboration and service delivery
- Facilitate communication between all parties to resolve queries and progress placements efficiently

Performance Monitoring & MI
- Monitor facility performance, including pipeline activity, quote-to-bind ratios, and general placement metrics
- Accurately capture and log key data to support MI reporting
- Provide feedback and insights to key stakeholders to support continuous improvement

Operational Support
- Support the delivery of the Aquarius proposition across the Willis Network
- Assist with onboarding new brokers and supporting adoption of the facility
- Contribute to process improvements and enhancement of the placement journey

Stakeholder Engagement & Events
- Participate in internal and external meetings as required
- Represent the Aquarius facility at occasional Willis Network Broker events, supporting awareness and engagement

What you'll bring:
- Strong experience within the insurance industry
- Strong knowledge of Commercial Combined insurance, with a focus on the SME sector
- Experience within the UK company/composite insurance market (non-Lloyd's preferred)
- Proven ability to manage and coordinate insurance placements or facility business
- Strong administrative and organisational skills with high attention to detail
- Ability to accurately capture, manage, and analyse data/metrics
- Confident stakeholder management and relationship-building skills
- Effective communication skills, both written and verbal
- Cert CII / Dip CII (or working towards) - desirable
- Highly organised with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
- conscientious with a strong focus on quality and accuracy
- Proactive and solutions-focused
- Strong relationship builder with a cooperative approach
- Comfortable working in a busy, evolving, and digitally enabled environment

Why Join Aquarius?

Aquarius is a strategic initiative designed to digitise and enhance SME placements, delivering efficient, data-led placement solutions for brokers, clients, and insurer partners. The role provides a unique opportunity to be at the centre of a growing, high-profile facility and contribute to its continued success and expansion.

Enjoy a benefits package designed to help you thrive, both professionally and personally. You'll receive 25 days of annual leave plus an extra WTW day to relax and recharge. Our comprehensive health and wellbeing offering includes private healthcare, life insurance, group income protection, and regular health assessments, all giving you peace of mind. Secure your future with our defined contribution pension scheme, featuring matched contributions up to 10% from the company.

We support your growth and balance with hybrid working options, access to an employee assistance programme, and a fully paid volunteer day to make a difference in your community. On top of these, you can opt into a variety of additional perks including an electric vehicle car scheme, share scheme, cycle-to-work programme, dental and optical cover, critical illness protection, and much more. Start making the most of your career and wellbeing with a range of benefits tailored for you.
